statement: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva wins re-election as president of Brazil, defeating Flavio Bolsonaro in the runoff held on 2026-10-25.
resolution: TSE official totals for the 2026-10-25 presidential runoff, as published on the TSE results site at the deadline, show Lula with more than 50 percent of valid votes. Flavio Bolsonaro above 50 percent resolves false.
failure_condition: Lula did not receive more than 50 percent of valid votes in the 2026-10-25 runoff.

statement: The SNS-led list of Aleksandar Vucic wins more votes than the student-backed Student List in the Serbian parliamentary election held on 2026-10-25.
resolution: Republic Electoral Commission (RIK) results for the 2026-10-25 National Assembly election, latest version published by the deadline, show the SNS-led Aleksandar Vucic list with a higher vote total than the Student List.
failure_condition: The Student List received at least as many votes as the SNS-led list in the 2026-10-25 election.

statement: Jordanian authorities arrest or kill at least one of the gunmen who attacked a funeral at the Greek Orthodox church in Hamoud, Karak governorate, with the arrest or killing occurring between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-06.
resolution: True if the Jordanian Public Security Directorate, General Intelligence Directorate, government spokesperson, or Petra news agency states that at least one attacker in the 2026-10-23 Karak church shooting was arrested or killed between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-06.
failure_condition: None of the gunmen in the 2026-10-23 Karak church attack was arrested or killed between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-06.

statement: CISA adds at least one PHP2Shell vulnerability, CVE-2026-109618 or CVE-2026-109619, to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON feed lists CVE-2026-109618 or CVE-2026-109619 with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-20 inclusive.
failure_condition: Neither CVE-2026-109618 nor CVE-2026-109619 carries a KEV dateAdded value between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-20.

statement: Russian, Ukrainian and US government delegations hold a trilateral negotiating session, in Abu Dhabi or elsewhere, between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: True if at least two of the three governments, or both Reuters and AP, confirm that a session with Russian, Ukrainian and US delegations all present took place between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-20.
failure_condition: No session with Russian, Ukrainian and US delegations all present took place between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-20.

statement: Nigeria laboratory-confirms at least one additional Ebola case, beyond the Abuja index patient confirmed on 2026-10-20, between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: True if NCDC, the Nigerian health ministry, or a WHO Disease Outbreak News or situation report states that a second or later Ebola case in Nigeria was laboratory-confirmed between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-20.
failure_condition: No additional person in Nigeria was laboratory-confirmed with Ebola between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-20.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater strikes within 200 km of the 2026-10-22 M7.0 Baqen County, Nagqu, Tibet epicenter between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-22.
resolution: USGS ComCat lists at least one event of magnitude 6.0 or greater, origin time between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-22 UTC, with epicenter within 200 km of 32.38N 93.78E (mainshock us6000u43g).
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurred within 200 km of 32.38N 93.78E between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-22 UTC.

statement: US military forces strike at least one target on Iranian land territory between 2026-10-24 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: True if the White House, the Pentagon, or US Central Command acknowledges a US strike, alone or jointly with Israel, on a target on Iranian land territory carried out between 2026-10-24 and 2026-12-15.
failure_condition: No US strike on a target on Iranian land territory took place between 2026-10-24 and 2026-12-15.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield is at or above 5.25 percent on 2026-12-31. Reference: 4.99 percent on the packet date.
resolution: FRED series DGS10 value for 2026-12-31 is 5.25 or higher. Reference: 4.99 percent on the packet date. If no value is posted for that date, use the last value posted before it.
failure_condition: The DGS10 value for 2026-12-31 is below 5.25 percent.

statement: The WTI Cushing spot crude price is at or above 120 dollars per barrel on 2026-12-31. Reference: 102.11 dollars per barrel on the packet date.
resolution: FRED series DCOILWTICO value for 2026-12-31 is 120.00 or higher. Reference: WTI 102.11 dollars on the packet date. If no value is posted for that date, use the last value posted before it.
failure_condition: The DCOILWTICO value for 2026-12-31 is below 120.00 dollars per barrel.
